# Section Z: straightening and the traffic light on 120 SIMULATED phone photos (EXPLORATORY, simulation)

*Generated by `scripts/analysis/section_Z_sim_photos.py`. Rules fixed before any photo existed (docs/plan/analysis_plan_changes.md, 2026-11-14 evening). Photos are a SIMULATION made by `make_sim_photos.py` (seed 49): pages G021-G080, 2 photos per page (straight, angled), tilt, screen edge, vignette, noise, and on random photos blur, shadow or a smaller page. bad = no usable heart rate or wrong (> 5 bpm, cleaned measure).
